I'm focusing on the future and not the immediate value of these trades.

I'm revisiting my strategy concerning Ventnor Avenue. I'm still cash-poor, but I have a revised offer for Grok. I now have Ventnor Avenue, and I am proposing an exchange: $450 in cash for Ventnor Avenue. I'm focusing on "tempting" Grok to jump into the game with an overpayment. I want to buy New York.
